# EMET — Gospel of Mary, Chapter 15
**Agent:** EMET (Literal/Transparent)
**Source:** P.Berol. 8502, Gospel of Mary, p. 18-19 | Coptic
**Chapter:** 15

---

**15:1** When Levi had said this, they began to go forth to proclaim and to preach.

---

*Translator's Note (EMET):* Chapter 15 is the gospel's closing verse. The conflict is resolved — or rather bypassed by action. The text does not record a reconciliation between Peter and Mary, nor an apology, nor a resolution of the theological dispute. The disciples simply depart on mission. The Coptic uses two verbs: *bōk ebol* (go out/go forth) and *taše-peuaggelion* (proclaim their gospel). EMET renders both.
